description: Requires a free Messe Atlas account (sign in when prompted). The halls and rooms of one venue (slug or uuid from search_venues): kind, level, area m², width, length, clear height, floor load, column-free, capacities (theatre, classroom, banquet, cocktail, 3×3 booths), doors, utilities, notes, and each row's `source_url` and `as_of` (`stale` when older than 180 days). A null figure is not published by the venue. Drawings are not served; `geometry_status` says whether Atlas holds an outline.

venue.description: Venue slug or uuid from search_venues / get_venue.
